questions.question: A wise saying tells people to cast their bread upon the waters. What does it say will happen after many days?

answers.text: It will reach a far land
It will be gone for good

questions.question: Why does a wise teacher say to divide your portion among seven or even eight?

answers.text: You don't know what disaster may come
Whatever you keep will spoil anyway
Sharing will bring you honor in the city

questions.question: A wise teacher says that if a man lives many years, what should he do in them all?
A wise teacher says to remember the days of darkness. What does he say about those days?
